snippet.title: No One Leaves the Field - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
No One Leaves the Field is a first-person folk horror game set on a cursed farm where the wheat shifts each time you enter. Search for your car keys, uncover the family’s dark ritual, and beware-something ancient walks between the stalks.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652690/No_One_Leaves_the_Field/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
